title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen.

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender.

Konkret:

  • ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt.
  • DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden.
  • ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste

Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. The Trainer is our pedagogical and platform expert within the Professional Services (PS) team. Your mission is to empower our clients to build Collaborative Learning organizations by mastering our platform and methodology. You aren't a technical expert; you are a pedagogical and platform expert who ensures that clients don’t just "use" the software, but master it to drive long-term engagement.

By owning our "One-to-Many" offer (Engagement Academy & Stadium webinars), you ensure that every client, from their first day of implementation, has the knowledge and confidence to make their project a success. You don't just deliver content; you develop a scalable learning ecosystem that ensures every client gets the best start possible by mastering our Collaborative Learning methodology.

You will work closely with the Customer Success Team and Product teams to ensure our training offer addresses the actual friction points and needs of our client base.

 


Within 1 month, you will:

  • Master our Platform's core user experience and the Collaborative Learning methodology 

  • Become a platform expert (from a user & admin perspective) and get certified on our methodology.

  • Shadow existing Stadium webinars and Academy workflows to understand the current "One-to-Many" engine.

  • Connect with colleagues worldwide through virtual coffee chats and team-building activities.


    • Within 3 months, you will:

  • Host your Stadium webinars and receive peer feedback on your ability to drive platform engagement.

  • Identify and execute your updates on the Engagement Academy to align with the latest product releases.

  • Define your quarterly priorities in relation to the Support & Services roadmap with your coach.

title: Solution Expert
description:
Our Solution Expert team plays a key role in supporting strategic customers in RUN phase, by acting as trusted advisors on complex use cases. Working closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success, they analyze advanced client needs, challenge existing setups, and translate requirements into scalable solutions within the 360Learning platform.
 
You will manage a portfolio of customers throughout their lifecycle to drive product adoption and deliver tailored solutions beyond standard product capabilities.
 
These large and strategic accounts have already deployed the platform and have a strong level of autonomy. They rely on your technical and functional expertise to lead complex integrations (APIs, flat files, third-party tools), redesign platform architecture, run solution audits, and provide high-level recommendations to maximize business impact and long-term value.

Within 1 month, you will:
  • Become a Trello expert through our onboarding process
  • Understand our product offering through training
  • Master our platform and be able to support clients on basics requests through ticketing

    • Within 3 months, you will:
  • Own your portfolio of 10 enterprise clients & leading up to 30 active projects simultaneously
  • Start to answer questions coming from your portfolio of clients
  • Support the Customer Success partner on functional and technical questions
  • Successfully implement integration (SSO, third-party tools), deliver technical expertise on how to integrate their learning platform to their technical environment & troubleshooting

    • Within 6 months, you will:
  • Be able to pitch the value of the 360Learning platform
  • Develop repeatable and scalable pro

title: Solution Deployment Manager
description:
As our Solution Deployment Manager, you are part of our Implementation team, which plays a key role in onboarding seamlessly new customers: they are working cross department (Sales, Product and Customer Success) to understand and document client use cases and requirements and then translate them into set up and configuration of the 360Learning platform. 
 
You will manage all phases of the implementation lifecycle, from sales turnover and kick off to handover to support. You will drive project management, define 360Learning platform architecture for our clients, facilitate integrations (flat files, API’s) and 3rd party apps, guide and provide assistance in order to ensure the successful deployment of their platform.
 
In addition, you will follow your customers' portfolio along their contract to increase product adoption, as well as to deliver Solutions complementary to the Product like platform audits.

  • Become a Trello expert through our onboarding process
  • Understand our product offering through training

description:

You will join a team focused on maximizing renewal and upsell opportunities across a large portfolio of existing customers through automation, data-driven prioritization, and scalable account management strategies.

You will manage a high-volume portfolio of customers ranging from 100 to 2,500 employees, with a focus on identifying growth opportunities, driving renewals, and increasing customer engagement at scale through automatization actions. 

At 360Learning, the KAM Pool role is a unique opportunity to also shape the overall KAM team. It combines account management, revenue generation, and operational excellence. Your mission is to build scalable motions that accelerate expansion opportunities while ensuring customers continue to realize value from the platform. Therefore, your successful automatization processes will also help shape globally the entire KAM team.

title: Key Account Manager Mid Market
description:
As a Key Account Manager (KAM), you play a decisive role in the growth of 360Learning's business and you will join a team of 5 KAMs (Mid-market). You will be in charge of around 100 accounts (existing customers from 100 to 2,500 employees).
 
At 360Learning, the KAM role is 80% sales oriented and your goal is to develop your portfolio and generate growth. But, you will not work alone! Client Success Partners and internal experts (digital pedagogy, platform structuring, IT) are in charge of the client’s project monitoring and execution. Collaborating with these teams will be instrumental to succeed in your upsell actions. 
 
We are eager to retain the best talent in our teams, and we will encourage internal moves after 2-3 years of continuous success to build together fulfilling career paths. This KAM Mid-role offers the possibility of moving to a KAM Large position (existing customers from 2,500 to 10,000+ employees).

title: Head of GTM Systems & AI
description:
Introduction to the Team & Role

 
What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
 
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
 
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.
 

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.

title: Retail Area Manager
description:
What you'll do:
  • Support new store launches in France, helping coordinate with franchise and store partners to ensure smooth openings, proper training, and operational readiness.
  • Track store performance and support revenue growth by monitoring trends, helping optimize costs, and flagging risks early.
  • Monitor OTIF (On-Time, In-Full) deliveries, support inventory tracking, and help resolve day-to-day operational issues with logistics teams.
  • Help apply and roll out playbooks and best practices across stores, contributing ideas to improve conversion rates and customer experience.
  • Track NPS and customer feedback, support store staff with ongoing training needs, and help implement improvements.
  • Support store audits, assist with mystery shopping programs, and help maintain accurate reporting on sales, marketing performance, and inventory.

    • Who we're looking for:
  • Comfortable working on store launches and supporting performance improvements.
  • Strong with data and numbers, especially around store performance, inventory, and customer feedback.
  • Hands-on problem solver who can react quickly in fast-paced environments.
  • Collaborative and comfortable working with franchise partners, store teams, and internal stakeholders.
  • Customer-focused and motivated to improve in-store experience and satisfaction.
  • Fluent in English and French, other European languages are a plus.

    • What we offer:
  • Growth opportunity in a rapidly growing company.
  • Supportive team environment, working locally and globally.
  • Career development with access to continuous learning and training.
  • Competitive compensation and health benefits.

title: Business Development Manager, EU Airport transfers (all genders)
description:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Business Development Manager, focus on Market Expansion, build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to building a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

title: (Senior) Creator Marketing Coordinator (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Du weißt, was erfolgreiche Creator-Kampagnen ausmacht, erkennst Trends bevor sie viral gehen und hast ein Gespür für starke Markenstrategien? Dann bist du hier genau richtig!

In dieser Rolle bringst du dein strategisches Know-how ein, arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Kunden und Creators und gestaltest innovative Marketingansätze, die echten Impact haben. 

Wenn du Lust hast, die Zukunft der Creator Economy mitzugestalten und deine Expertise auf das nächste Level zu heben – let’s talk!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Strategische Kampagnensteuerung: Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen mit Fokus auf Performance und Brand Awareness
  • Enge Kundenbetreuung: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Key Account Management zur Sicherstellung der individuellen Kundenstrategie
  • Projektmanagement: Erstellung von wöchentlichen Updates, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Kundenterminen sowie Entwicklung langfristiger Kundenbindungsmaßnahmen
  • Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen: Identifikation von Trends, Analyse des Wettbewerbsumfeldes und Ableitung strategischer Maßnahmen
  • Budget- & Margenverantwortung: Steuerung und Kontrolle von Kosten, Budgets und Margenzielen zur Sicherstellung der wirtschaftlichen Effizienz

title: Head of Product Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du bist die Brücke zwischen unserer Produktentwicklung und einem der stärksten Performance-Marketing-Teams im europäischen D2C: Jeder Schuh verlässt bei dir die Entwicklung mit fertiger Launch-Story, belegten Aussagen und Creative-Angles. Und du baust den Insight-Motor auf, der aus Millionen Ad-Kommentaren und einem eigenen Kunden-Panel die Produkt-Briefs von morgen macht. Bei Pammys ist Product Marketing keine Übersetzungs-Abteilung — es sitzt im Produktbereich und entscheidet, welches Produkt für welche Nische gebaut wird.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du planst und steuerst unsere Produktlaunches: Timing, Positionierung, Abstimmung mit Performance, Creator-Team, CRM und Shop
  • Du baust unsere Insights-Funktion auf: ein eigenes Kunden-Panel, Segmentierung, qualitative Interviews — und die systematische Auswertung von Community- und Anzeigen-Feedback
  • Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Produkt-Briefs: Passform- und Komfort-Themen, Wünsche, nächste Modell-Ideen — direkt in die Produktentwicklung und zum Founder
  • Du lieferst Botschaft und Angle-Hypothesen an das Creative-Team — Testergebnisse aus den Kampagnen fließen zurück in deinen Insight-Kreislauf
  • Du entwickelst pro Produkt die Kernbotschaft: welches Problem es löst, für wen, warum jetzt – und briefst damit Creative-Team und Creator

title: Junior Complaints & Compliance Specialist
description:
Complaints and Compliance Specialist

Location: Berlin (office first)

The team

The Complaints team sits within Operations and works every day to make sure merchants who run their businesses on SumUp get fair, fast, and compliant resolutions whenever something goes wrong with a payment. As payment volumes grow, so does the complexity of the cases the team handles, from delayed payouts to disputed chargebacks, and this role exists to build the specialist skills needed to resolve these cases with precision and care. Joining now means learning the mechanics of payment processing from the ground up, working closely with Risk, Engineering, and Finance, and helping shape how SumUp responds to some of its most sensitive merchant and regulatory moments.

What you'll do

  • Investigate and resolve merchant complaints tied to payment processing, including authorisations, settlements, payouts, and chargebacks
  • Dig into processor logs, payment gateways, and payout systems to find the root cause of each issue and document the findings clearly
  • Draft clear, compliant final responses to merchants that meet regulatory timelines and internal SLAs
  • Work closely with Payment Operations, Risk, Engineering, and Finance to unblock complex cases
  • Keep case documentation audit ready and flag emerging patterns or recurring issues to the wider team
  • Contribute to playbooks and knowledge base articles that help the team resolve future cases faster

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Foundational understanding of payment processing, covering authorisations, settlements, payouts, and basic chargebacks
  • Comfort working with a CRM or ticketing system, following SOPs, and keeping precise, audit ready documentation
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, customer friendly responses under regulatory constraints</

SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.

Your Role: Drive Sales Performance & Velocity

As Revenue Operations Manager for Sales Excellence, you will be the strategic partner to our Sales leadership and the operational engine behind our Account Executives. Across the SaaS industry, sales cycles have recently increased by 3-4 weeks on average. Furthermore, industry-wide SQL to Closed-Won conversion rates have dropped. Your core mission is to counteract these market headwinds by optimizing our sales mechanics, critical processes, and pipeline management.

You will ensure that our AEs spend less time on administrative friction and more time executing a frictionless, high-converting sales process tailored to our mid-market European buyers.

  • Optimize our Buyer Journey: Tailor our Salesforce deal stages and qualification methodology to engage the right stakeholders at the right time. Specifically, build workflows that help AEs navigate the Head of IT, who acts as the primary decision-maker in our core mid-market deals.

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.

Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
 
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
 
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
 
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.
 
We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

title: Co-Founder - Business, Finance & Commercial (m/f/d)
description:
Kali Energy is a Berlin-based pre-seed startup developing industrial thermal energy storage technology to help decarbonize industrial process heat. Our founders are engineers with prior hands-on experience taking an industrial-scale thermal energy storage system from early-stage development through to manufacturing handover. We are now applying that experience to build a more efficient next-generation system.

We are currently validating our proof-of-concept test rig, applying for the EXIST Gründungsstipendium through our host university, and in active discussions with investors. EXIST is one path we are pursuing, not our only one.

This is not a standard employment role. It is an opportunity to join as a founding co-founder with equalownership over the company's commercial direction, from company registration onward.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a full-time co-founder to lead the business, finance, and commercial side of the company. You will complement our technical founding team and become the face of the company to investors and customers.

Both of us are engineers. We need someone who will challenge us on the business side, own fundraising, and talk to clients and investors directly.

Tasks

  • Own business and financial planning, including financial modelling, pricing strategy, and fundraising materials
  • Lead investor conversations, due diligence preparation, and grant or non-dilutive funding applications
  • Lead go-to-market strategy and early sales efforts in our target industry
  • Develop partnerships with relevant industry players
  • Manage company registration and commercial operations
  • Contribute to hiring as the team grows

Requirements

Must have

  • A background in business, finance, economics, or marketing, OR a technical degree combined with an MBA, OR project management experience with budget own

Wemolo runs its commercial engine on Salesforce and RevOps owns it — along with the wider system landscape around it. Our data model is non-standard and our motion is anything but off-the-shelf, so we need an experienced admin who can run and improve the whole setup largely on their own, with the Head of RevOps as a soundboard. What to Expect

  • Ownership: Own Salesforce as our commercial system of record — its health, architecture and evolution across our data model, run and improve the surrounding system landscape (Weflow, Demodesk, Amplemarket and their integrations).

  • Architecture: Drive Salesforce architecture improvements so pipeline data becomes trustworthy.

  • Build: Build no-code / low-code configuration (Flows etc.) customizing and combining tools to solve recurring operational problems.

  • Cross-functional impact: Own changes that span Marketing, BizDev, Sales, CSM, Product and Finance and never deploy one without bringing the affected users along. A change is done when it's adopted, not when it ships.

  • AI-first: Put AI to work in daily admin — drafting validation rules, auditing duplicates, QA — in line with our heavy AI bet.

  • Enablement: Provide technical mentoring to our Junior GTM Engineer and guide the working students on Salesforce and systems topics.

description: 회사 소개   쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      직무 소개   Account Management 팀은 판매자의 성장을 지원하고 Marketplace의 지속적인 비즈니스 성과 향상에 기여하는 조직입니다. 담당 셀러의 비즈니스 현황을 분석하고 성장 기회를 발굴하여 매출 확대를 위한 전략을 제안합니다. 셀러와 긴밀하게 협업하며 프로모션, 가격 경쟁력, 상품 운영 등 다양한 성장 활동을 지원합니다. 데이터 기반의 인사이트와 컨설팅을 통해 셀러의 비즈니스 성과 개선 및 장기적인 파트너십 구축을 목표로 합니다.      업무 내용    마켓플레이스 셀러의 포트폴리오를 관리하며, 비즈니스 현황을 분석하고 성장 기회를 발굴  마켓플레이스 셀러의 비즈니스 현황과 주요 성과 (매출, 트래픽, 전환율 등) 지표를 분석하고, 매출 성장을 위한 영업 전략 수립·실행  프로모션, 상품 운영 개선 등을 통해 셀러의 비즈니스 성과 향상 지원  셀러의 니즈와 문제점을 파악하고 데이터 기반의 솔루션을 제안하여 지속적인 성장을 지원       자격   요건    영업, Account Management, Business Development 또는 관련 분야에서 최소 3년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  고객 또는 파트너 비즈니스 관리 경험이 있으신 분  데이터와 지표를 기반으로 문제를 분석하고 해결한 경험이 있으신 분  우수한 커뮤니케이션 및 관계 구축 역량이 있으신 분  목표 달성을 위한 강한 실행력과 오너십을 가지신 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 우선순위를 설정하고 다양한 과제를 효과적으로 관리할 수 있는 분  셀러의 니즈를 깊이 이해하고 데이터 기반의 솔루션을 통해 비즈니스 성과를 개선한 경험이 있으신 분       우대   사항    이커머스 또는 온라인 플랫폼 관련 경험이 있으신 분  B2B 영업 또는 고객 관리 경험이 있으신 분  판매자 관리 또는 고객 성공(Customer Success) 경험이 있으신 분  Excel, SQL 또는 BI Tool 활용 경험이 있으신 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항    전형절차    서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.    참고사항    본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급

description: Role: Customer Success Manager, AMR     Location:  성수동 (서울숲역-뚝섬역 부근)   Reporting to: Team Manager   '세계 최고의 AI 기반 모빌리티 플랫폼 기업'으로 성장하고 있는 베어로보틱스에서 각 분야에서 최고 수준의 동료들과 함께 할 여러분을 기다립니다.  베어로보틱스는 현재 미국, 한국, 일본 등 전 세계 200명+ 이상의 직원들이 긴밀하게 협업하고 있으며 로봇 소프트웨어 플랫폼 구축, 군집제어 기술, 클라우드 관제 솔루션 등의 분야에 우수한 기술력을 보유하고 있습니다.베어로보틱스는 서빙로봇을 시작으로 전 세계 20여개국에서 약 2만대의 AI 기반 서비스 로봇을 공급하고 있습니다. 최근에 선보인 AMR(Autonomous Mobile Robot)은 로봇 트래픽을 제어하는 자체 로봇 플랫폼을 통해 물류 프로세스간 무중단·원격 자율이동로봇 솔루션을 제공하고 있으며,한 공간에 최대 1000여대의 로봇을 효율적으로 운영할 수 있는 군집제어 기술에서 경쟁력을 가지고 있다는 평가를 받고 있습니다.베어로보틱스는 2024년 6천만달러의 투자를 받은데 이어, LG전자의 지분 추가 인수를 통한 경영권 확보로 2025년 5월 LG전자의 계열회사로 편입되었습니다.  앞으로 전 세계로 더욱 확장할 베어로보틱스와 함께, 수많은 혁신을 만들어가며 본인의 역량을 마음껏 발휘하실 여러분을 모십니다.   ⭐ 포지션 소개   Bear Robotics는 자율주행 로봇(AMR)을 통해 전 세계 물류 및 제조 환경에서 실제로 운영되는 로봇 시스템을 만들고 있습니다.  로봇이 고객사 현장에 도입된 이후,  고객이 로봇을 통해 지속적으로 가치를 얻고, 안정적인 서비스 경험을 누리도록 만드는 것 이 이 포지션의 핵심입니다.  AMR Customer Service PM은 성공적인 Implementation이 완료된 고객 사이트를 FPM(Field Project Manager)으로부터 인계받아, 해당 사이트의 CS 운영 전반을 처음부터 끝까지 책임지는 역할입니다. 고객사에서 접수되는 문의·장애 대응을 총괄하고, 고객·현장 서비스 엔지니어·본사 엔지니어링 팀 사이를 조율하며, SLA와 일정·리소스를 관리해 약속된 서비스 품질을 지켜냅니다.  직접 장비를 수리하는 역할이 아니라,  여러 고객 사이트의 CS 운영을 체계적으로 기획·관리하고 이끌며, 고객과의 신뢰 관계를 유지하는 역할 입니다. 서비스 데이터와 고객의 목소리를 분석해 개선 우선순위를 정하고, 이를 본사 제품·엔지니어링 팀에 전달하여 제품과 서비스 품질 향상을 주도합니다.   What You'll Do     성공적인 Implementation 완료 후 해당 고객 사이트를 FPM(Field Project Manager)으로부터 인계받아 CS 관리 수행  담당 고객사의 CS 운영(장애 대응, 유지보수, 운영 지원)을 end-to-end로 총괄  서비스 요청(티켓)의 접수부터 해결까지 전 과정을 관리하고 SLA 준수 및 대응 품질 확보  (내/외부) 서비스 엔지니어 파견 요청 등 스케줄을 관리하여 적시 AMR Repair 달성  주요 Spare Part 사용량 분석·예측을 포함한 재고량 파악 및 관리  고객, 현장 서비스 엔지니어, 본사 엔지니어링·제품팀 사이의 커뮤니케이션 및 의사결정 조율  정기 점검·예방 정비 일정 등 서비스 리소스 계획 및 운영  주요 이슈에 대한 에스컬레이션 총괄 및 해결까지의 진행 상황 관리  서비스 지표·이슈 트렌드를 분석하여 개선 과제를 도출하고, 제품·엔지니어링 팀에 반영 요청  사이트별 서비스 프로세스·플레이북 표준화 및 문서화     What We're Looking For    [Required]     로봇·산업 장비·자동화 설비 등 기술 제품 분야에서 고객사를 직접 응대하며 사후 서비스·기술 지원을 관리해온 경력 5년 이상  장애 대응·유지보수 등 서비스 운영을 SLA 기준에 맞춰 책임지고 관리해 본 경험  서비스 인력 파견, 일정, 예비 부품 등 리소스를 조율하여 적시 대응(신속한 Repai
